title: Virtua Fighter CG Portrait Series Vol. 3: Akira Yuki
native_title: バーチャ・ファイター ＣＧポートレート・シリーズ Ｖｏｌ．３ 「結城 晶」
overview:
Character CG from Virtua Fighter and an image song blend together beautifully...

Volume 3 of the CG Portrait Series is devoted to Akira Yuki. Newly made computer graphics show him training - striking in the dojo, kicking among the trees and sparring in a courtyard - in a sequence staged to his image song "Natsu no Arashi", a single from the Virtua Fighter 2 vocal album Dancing Shadows.

Choose "Karaoke" and the lyrics appear on screen so you can sing along.

- Original CG portraits of Akira Yuki
- Image song with a karaoke mode

「バーチャファイター」のキャラクターCGとイメージソングが華麗に融合する…
